evals.name: explicit-api-integration
evals.prompt: I need to implement the forgot password feature. The backend has an endpoint at /api/auth/forgot-password that sends a reset email. Please implement the frontend integration with proper error handling.
evals.expected_output: Should follow the 4-phase workflow: read Swagger/controller, define Zod schemas for wrapper and inner data, implement in lib/api/, and verify by calling the endpoint

evals.name: feature-with-backend-data
evals.prompt: Add a device management page where users can see all their registered devices and revoke specific ones. Each device shows name, last active time, and platform.
evals.expected_output: Should recognize this involves backend API calls, read the device-related endpoints in Swagger/controller, define proper schemas, and verify the integration

evals.name: api-error-debugging
evals.prompt: The leaderboard page is showing 'Please try again later' for all errors but I know there are specific error codes like LEADERBOARD_NOT_AVAILABLE and USER_NOT_IN_LEADERBOARD. Fix the error handling to show proper messages.
evals.expected_output: Should identify the error code extraction issue (error.data.code vs error.error), check mapApiErrorCode for missing codes, and verify by testing error scenarios
